procurement_clauses.requirement: Define the public task, same-task non-AI route, equity measure and stop rule before award.
procurement_clauses.acceptance_evidence: approved public-value schedule and published baseline

procurement_clauses.requirement: Publish purpose, model or rule, version, supplier dependencies, limitations and material changes before release.
procurement_clauses.acceptance_evidence: public AI register entry and dated change log

procurement_clauses.requirement: Enforce declared inputs, prohibited inputs, role-based access, retention and subprocessor limits.
procurement_clauses.acceptance_evidence: access matrix, configuration evidence and retention test

procurement_clauses.requirement: Give the public client and independent reviewer access to logs, tests, interfaces and subcontractor evidence needed for audit.
procurement_clauses.acceptance_evidence: audit-rights schedule and successful evidence retrieval rehearsal

procurement_clauses.requirement: Make the same task usable through staffed and non-digital routes and require independent accessibility acceptance before release.
procurement_clauses.acceptance_evidence: signed review record with unresolved material barriers at zero

procurement_clauses.requirement: Block unreviewed model, prompt, data, interface, component or retention changes and publish approved material changes.
procurement_clauses.acceptance_evidence: change request, impact assessment, regression result and public notice

procurement_clauses.requirement: Require documented open input/output schemas, exportable records and replaceable hardware/software interfaces.
procurement_clauses.acceptance_evidence: schema package, export test and supplier-substitution rehearsal

procurement_clauses.requirement: Name a pending-to-confirm duty role, immediate notification window, pause authority, correction and public close-out.
procurement_clauses.acceptance_evidence: incident rehearsal receipt and escalation contact test

procurement_clauses.requirement: Keep ordinary passage, printed information, telephone referral and staffed same-task service available during outages and exit.
procurement_clauses.acceptance_evidence: continuity drill with AI power/data isolated

procurement_clauses.requirement: Require documented transition, knowledge transfer, asset inventory, export/return and supplier cooperation at expiry or termination.
procurement_clauses.acceptance_evidence: accepted exit plan and handover inventory

procurement_clauses.requirement: Delete service data, backups and subprocessor copies when due, subject only to an authorized documented hold.
procurement_clauses.acceptance_evidence: deletion certificates plus independent sample verification

procurement_clauses.requirement: Remove reversible equipment with the documented tools, protect the accessible route and sort assets for reuse/return.
procurement_clauses.acceptance_evidence: deinstallation method, asset disposition log and clear-route inspection

procurement_clauses.requirement: Restore interfaces and finishes to the agreed ordinary-service condition and remedy defects before final payment.
procurement_clauses.acceptance_evidence: before/after record and independent restoration acceptance
